critique: The note proves the advertised two-sided minimax rate over both bounded classes, including a valid bounded-class converse and matching clipped-SNIPE achievability; no conjecture or assumed crux carries the headline. The result determines rates only up to constants for the unrestricted estimator class, while the exact constant is proved solely for block-local linear unbiased estimators on complete blocks. The claimed complete representer characterization is an exact criterion through the finite extremal functional Psi, not an explicit parametrization of every optimal weight collection. The fixed common propensity, fixed interaction order, known graph, and absence of inference theory keep the contribution at field level rather than flagship, but these limitations do not contradict the TL;DR or project justification.
